title: Database Connection Leak Causes Gradual Checkout Degradation
summary_for_humans: A checkout-service release introduced a database connection leak in a retry loop. Connections are acquired but not closed on one exception path. Across four hours, active and idle-in-transaction connections accumulate, pool wait time and request latency rise, then the pool saturates and checkout requests time out. Traffic and CPU spikes are downstream effects; a routine reporting query and a small campaign traffic increase are decoys.
agent_note: This file is incident metadata, not ground truth. Do not expose ground_truth.json to investigating agents.
